title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 117 (Resolutions and agreements to be filed)

content.overview: A copy of every resolution or agreement in respect of matters specified in section 117(3), together with any section 102 explanatory statement, shall be filed with the Registrar within thirty days of the passing or making thereof. Covered matters include special resolutions, certain unanimous member resolutions, managing-director appointment resolutions, class resolutions, voluntary winding-up resolutions and prescribed Board resolutions. Penalties apply for default.
content.glance: Specified resolutions and agreements under section 117(3) must be filed with the Registrar within thirty days, with any section 102 statement.
content.study:
## Section 117 — Resolutions and agreements to be filed

**Filing duty.** Section 117(1) requires a copy of each resolution or agreement covered by subsection (3), together with any explanatory statement under section 102, to be filed with the Registrar within thirty days of passing or making it.

**Covered list (subsection (3)).** Includes special resolutions; resolutions agreed to by all members that would otherwise have required a special resolution; Board resolutions or agreements relating to managing-director appointment, re-appointment, renewal or variation of terms; class resolutions; voluntary winding-up resolutions; and other resolutions or agreements as listed or prescribed. Do not assume every ordinary resolution must be filed under this section.

**Consequences.** Failure to file may attract the penalty in the applicable version of section 117. Non-filing does not automatically void the resolution for every purpose; apply the statutory consequences to the facts.

This note is a focused study aid; the topic remains under source and current-law review.
